This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 159/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Rehetgaon, District Harda for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2)(N) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 27.05.2022.

The first application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 6th of September, 2022 passed in MCRC No. 41158/2022 with liberty to renew the same after recording the statement of prosecutrix.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the statements of prosecutrix and other witnesses have been record and they have been declared hostile, therefore this application may be considered and allowed.
Learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application.
Taking note of the statements of the prosecutrix and other witnesses and also the period of custody of applicant, I am inclined to consider this application.
Accordingly, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE RAGHVENDRA Keshu Durve (Korku) vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/102183606/
